text:
Lola Nguyen: hey team! Lola here — joining from a tiny apartment in Austin. I bike to work, make an excellent guac, and I bring my own playlist for focus. excited to be here :wave:

Mike Tran: welcome Lola!! where in Austin? tacos asap? :taco:

Lola Nguyen: north side — Domain area. Franklin's is my weakness. Also curious about desk setups: standing desk available?

Sasha (People Ops): hi Lola, welcome!! we have adjustable desks in the SF office — just ping facilities for a keyboard tray. swag is ready at reception if you want hoodies/size. drop by anytime today between 10-4.

Juno Park: hi and welcome! plant question: are you a low-light survivor or full-sun diva? we have a little plant swap table near the kitchenette. :seedling:

Lola Nguyen: low-light survivor. snake plant or pothos for me. also… is there an unofficial friday thing? hammock?

Ben Ortiz: hammock approx every other friday weather permitting. bring snacks. :+1:

Mike Tran: @Lola Nguyen i'll be your onboarding buddy — can give a quick tour and taco recs. also what keyboard do you like? ergo or compact?

Lola Nguyen: love an ergo for long typing sessions. but i've been tempted by a 60% for portability.

swag-bot: Lola — badge ready. Please stop by security desk with a valid ID to pick up access. :badge: 

Sasha (People Ops): FYI lunch onboarding today at 12:30 in the demo room — meet some of the product folks.

Mike Tran: tiny checklist:
```
1) badge pickup (done)
2) laptop + VPN setup (IT will ping you)
3) join #eng for runtime shenanigans
4) taco run if time
```

Lola Nguyen: omg taco run yes. thanks for the warm welcome y'all — excited to meet in person. also happy to bring emergency guac to the hammock day. :avocado:

Juno Park: mortal questions — coffee or tea? (poll)

Ben Ortiz: :coffee:

Mike Tran: :coffee: (black)

Lola Nguyen: :tea: green for me in the mornings, coffee for code review survival later.

eng-bot: quick note — welcome threads are piped to the new-hire tracker. @Sasha (People Ops) — adding Lola to the orientation spreadsheet.

Sasha (People Ops): got it, thanks eng-bot. see you at lunch @Lola Nguyen!
